mentions.name: Socratify
mentions.description: An AI interview coach that builds critical thinking and communication skills through dialogues about recent news and announcements at companies users want to work at. Users have a 2-minute conversation and get feedback on how they think and speak, positioned as a Duolingo for career goals.
mentions.source_excerpt:
An AI Interview Coach - Socratify

www.socratify.com

It focused on critical thinking and communication skills by having dialogues about recent news and announcements at the companies you want to work at. Have a 2 min dialogue and get feedback about how you think and speak.

Think of it as a Duolingo for your career goals
